name: Eastern Star (Ioun Stone)
body:
Price 4,000 gp; Slot none; CL 12th; Weight —; Aura strong divination

DESCRIPTION

This red crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star.

Its user understands spoken and written languages as if under the effects of comprehend languages.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells tongues
